#### Building on our BASIC SQL

At this point you can create a database and query a database.  So - [is that all there is](https://youtu.be/LCRZZC-DH7M?t=45){class="inline_disabled"}?

NO - it's time for the fun stuff!  We started playing with aggregates in homework 7, let's dive in and explore
some of the features that have kept SQL in business for all these years!

#### Notes on the Resources

Review ALL the resources above. Here are some additional notes:
    
[Learn SQL joins](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-12-learn-sql-joins) Another one of those cool Decomplexify videos.  Enjoy!


[Keys made easy](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-12-keys-made-easy) You've seen this before, but its a good reminder of Keys.


[Intro to joins](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-12-intro-to-joins) a quick intro to joins - worth your time.


[Joins - Part 1](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-12-joins-part-1) First of 2 on SQL.  Enjoy the entire series! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLi01XoE8jYojRqM4qGBF1U90Ee1Ecb5tt


[Joins - Part 2](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-12-joins-part-2) Second of 2 on SQL.  Enjoy the entire series! https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLi01XoE8jYojRqM4qGBF1U90Ee1Ecb5tt


[Database constraints](https://virginiacommonwealth.instructure.com/courses/122236/pages/resource-week-12-database-constraints) Insights into the why and how of database constraints.


[11 SQL Questions](https://medium.com/@ritika_DataAnalyst/11-practical-sql-interview-questions-i-failed-to-answer-during-an-interview-f3a40205ddff) is a fun reference on questions you might get asked about SQL for a job interview!  Hopefully, you'll know how to answer these questions by the end of the semester!
